pages.title: Sample Page
pages.content: This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this: Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.) ...or something like this: The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community. As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

pages.title: Help Center
pages.content: We are here to help. For any question about an order, a product or your account, email us at info@hassence.com . Please include your order number and mobile number so we can help you quickly. Common questions How do I place an order? Open the product you like, tap the + on the picture or press Buy now, then complete the checkout form. See our How to Buy page for every step. How can I pay? You can pay by Cash on Delivery or by Easypaisa / Raast QR. For QR payments, scan the QR code at checkout, pay, then upload your payment screenshot or type the Transaction ID. What are the courier charges? Courier charges depend on the product and are shown in your order total at checkout. One courier charge applies per delivery address. Can I return a product or get a refund? No. All sales are final. Please read our Return and Refund Policy before ordering. How do I write a review? Log in to your account. You can review a product after you have bought it. Contact us Email: info@hassence.com WhatsApp: +92 333 3848131 Address: Gurumandir, Jamsheed Quarters, Karachi, Pakistan

pages.title: How to Buy
pages.content: Shopping on Hassence takes just a few minutes. Find a product. Use the category tabs, the Categories button, the search bar or the Sort button to find what you want. Open the product. Check the picture, price, description and shipping information. Add it to your cart. Tap the + on the product picture to add it to your cart, or press Buy now to go straight to checkout. Choose the quantity first if you want more than one. Fill in your details. Enter your mobile number, your name and your delivery address. Check the total. Your courier charge is shown with your total before you pay. Choose how to pay. Pick Cash on Delivery , or Easypaisa / Raast QR . For QR, scan the code, pay the amount, then upload your payment screenshot or type the Transaction ID. Complete your order. Press Complete order . We will confirm your order and send it by courier. Need help? Email info@hassence.com or chat with us on WhatsApp using the green button.

pages.title: Return and Refund Policy
pages.content: No return and no refund. All orders placed on Hassence are final. We do not accept returns and we do not give refunds after an order is placed. Please check the product name, picture, description and price carefully before you order. If you have any question about a product, contact us before ordering at info@hassence.com or on WhatsApp at +92 333 3848131. By placing an order on hassence.com you agree to this policy.

pages.title: About Us
pages.content: Hassence is an online store based in Karachi, Pakistan. We are an e-commerce company that brings fragrances, fashion, beauty, electronics and lifestyle products together in one easy place to shop. Our goal is simple: good products, clear prices and an easy way to order from your phone. You can pay by Cash on Delivery or by Easypaisa / Raast QR, and we deliver across Pakistan by courier. What we offer A growing range of products in many categories New products added regularly Simple ordering and clear courier charges at checkout A marketplace where approved sellers can list their own products Want to sell on Hassence? Use the Sell on Hassence button at the top of the site. Questions? Email us at info@hassence.com .

pages.title: Careers
pages.content: Hassence is a growing e-commerce company in Karachi. We are always happy to hear from people who like online business and want to grow with us. Areas we hire in Customer support: answer customers by WhatsApp and email and follow up on orders Product listing and catalog: add products, photos, prices and descriptions to the website Digital marketing and social media: posts, ads and promotions Order and delivery coordination: pack orders and work with couriers Seller onboarding: help new sellers list their products How to apply Email your CV to info@hassence.com . Write the role you want in the subject line and tell us a little about yourself. If your profile fits, we will contact you. Location: Gurumandir, Jamsheed Quarters, Karachi, Pakistan.

pages.title: Contact Us
pages.content: We would love to hear from you. Email: info@hassence.com WhatsApp: +92 333 3848131 Address: Gurumandir, Jamsheed Quarters, Karachi, Pakistan When you write to us about an order, please include your order number and mobile number.
